profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, with the ticker DDOG and an SEC filing identifier of 0001561550. It also appears under the name DATADOG INC - CLASS A. Its website describes its offering as cloud monitoring as a service, presenting metrics from apps, tools and services in one place, and it invites visitors to try the product for free.

The site's security material describes defending against AI-powered attacks. Datadog says that integrating security and observability lets organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what it calls agentic speed.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in New York, where 458 matters are counted. No individual cases are listed.
